license_required.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice midwifery in this state unless such person is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter or s. 464.012.

type.quote: "Licensure" means authorization and license granted by the department for a person to engage in the practice of midwifery.

age_minimum.quote: Any person who seeks to practice midwifery in this state must be at least 21 years of age

degree_required.value: Graduation from an accredited and approved midwifery program or equivalent
degree_required.quote: Demonstrates that he or she has graduated from one of the following: (a) An accredited and approved midwifery program. (b) A medical or midwifery program offered in another state, jurisdiction, territory, or country whose graduation requirements were equivalent to or exceeded those required by s. 467.009

accrediting_body.value: Council for Higher Education Accreditation or accrediting agency approved by the United States Department of Education; Commission for Independent Education
accrediting_body.quote: demonstrates its accreditation by a member of the Council for Higher Education Accreditation or an accrediting agency approved by the United States Department of Education as an institutional accrediting agency for direct-entry midwifery education programs and its licensing or provisional licensing by the Commission for Independent Education.

degree_level.quote: An accredited and approved midwifery program may accept students who have both: (a) A high school diploma or its equivalent. (b) Taken three college-level credits each of math and English or demonstrated competencies in communication and computation.

school_approval_basis.quote: The department must approve an accredited or state-licensed public or private institution seeking to provide midwifery education and training as an approved midwifery program in this state

credential_pegged.quote: Demonstrates that he or she has graduated from one of the following: (a) An accredited and approved midwifery program.

required.quote: The department shall issue a license to practice midwifery to an applicant who meets all of the following criteria: (1) Demonstrates that he or she has graduated from one of the following: (a) An accredited and approved midwifery program.

experience_source.quote: The department shall issue a license to practice midwifery to an applicant who meets all of the following criteria: (1) Demonstrates that he or she has graduated from one of the following: (a) An accredited and approved midwifery program.

exams.name: Department-specified licensure examination
exams.notes: The department specifies the examination; details not stated in statute.
exams.quote: Demonstrates that he or she has received a passing score on an examination specified by the department.

exams.name: Prelicensure course
exams.notes: Completion of a prelicensure course covering Florida laws and rules, demonstrating competency, is required before licensure.
exams.quote: Demonstrates that he or she has successfully completed a prelicensure course offered by an accredited and approved midwifery program.

interval_years.quote: The department shall adopt rules establishing a procedure for the biennial renewal of licenses.

required.quote: The department may by rule prescribe continuing education requirements, not to exceed 20 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license.

hours_per_period.quote: not to exceed 20 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license.

period_years.quote: not to exceed 20 hours biennially, as a condition for renewal of a license.

value: clinical relevance to the practice of midwifery
prevention of medical errors (2-hour course, per umbrella ch. 456)
topical_requirements.quote: The programs have clinical relevance to the practice of midwifery

available.quote: The department shall issue a license by endorsement to practice midwifery to an applicant who demonstrates to the department that she or he meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145

requirements.value: Applicant must meet requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145 (MOBILE Act), submit application, and pay fee.
requirements.quote: The department shall issue a license by endorsement to practice midwifery to an applicant who demonstrates to the department that she or he meets the requirements for licensure by endorsement under s. 456.0145, submits an application for licensure on a form approved by the department, and pays the appropriate fee.

exists.quote: The Council of Licensed Midwifery is created within the department and shall consist of nine members to be appointed by the State Surgeon General.

name.quote: The Council of Licensed Midwifery is created within the department

authority.value: Assist and advise the department in developing rules; assist in developing rules for approval of midwifery training programs; monitor and inform the department on midwifery practice; educate the public; collect and review data; recommend changes to Midwifery Practice Act; address concerns of licensed midwives.
authority.quote: The council shall: (a) Assist and advise the department in developing rules relating to: training requirements, including core competencies, for persons training to become licensed midwives; the licensure examination; fees; the informed consent form; responsibilities of midwives; emergency care plans; records and reports to be filed by licensed midwives; and other regulatory requirements developed by the department.

national_association.value: American College of Nurse Midwives; Midwives Alliance of North America
national_association.quote: Core competencies, incorporating those established by the American College of Nurse Midwives and the Midwives Alliance of North America

regulatory_model.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice midwifery in this state unless such person is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter or s. 464.012.

credential_type.quote: "Licensure" means authorization and license granted by the department for a person to engage in the practice of midwifery.

is_mandatory.quote: it is unlawful for any person to practice midwifery in this state unless such person is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter or s. 464.012.

title_protection.quote: Using the name or title "midwife" or "licensed midwife" or any other name or title which implies that a person is licensed to practice midwifery, unless such person is duly licensed as provided in this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: Practicing midwifery, unless holding an active license to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring, attempting to procure, or renewing a license by bribery, fraudulent misrepresentation, or through department error.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring, attempting to procure, or renewing a license to practice midwifery by bribery, by fraudulent misrepresentation, or through an error of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a midwifery license revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against by another jurisdiction's licensing authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license to practice midwifery revoked, suspended, or otherwise acted against, including being denied licensure, by the licensing authority of another state, territory, or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted or found guilty of a crime directly relating to the practice of midwifery or the ability to practice midwifery.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty, regardless of adjudication, in any jurisdiction of a crime which directly relates to the practice of midwifery or to the ability to practice midwifery.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report or record, or intentionally or negligently failing to file a required report or record.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a false report or record, which the licensee knows to be false; intentionally or negligently failing to file a report or record required by state or federal law; or willfully impeding or obstructing such filing or inducing another to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct, including departure from or failure to conform to standards of practice established by the department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in unprofessional conduct, which includes, but is not limited to, any departure from, or the failure to conform to, the standards of practice of midwifery as established by the department, in which case actual injury need not be established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being unable to practice midwifery with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drunkenness, drug use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being unable to practice midwifery with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness; drunkenness; or use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or other materials or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report to the department any person known to be in violation of this chapter or department rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the department any person who the licensee knows is in violation of this chapter or of the rules of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any lawful order of the department previously entered in a disciplinary proceeding or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any lawful order of the department previously entered in a disciplinary proceeding or failing to comply with a lawfully issued subpoena of the department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of this chapter, chapter 456, or rules adopted thereunder.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any provision of this chapter or chapter 456, or any rules adopted pursuant thereto.

insurance_required.quote: the department shall, by rule, require that midwives maintain medical malpractice insurance or provide proof of financial responsibility in an amount and in a manner determined by the board or department to be sufficient to cover claims arising out of the rendering of or failure to render professional care and services in this state.

definition_quote.value: "Midwifery" means the practice of supervising the conduct of a normal labor and childbirth, with the informed consent of the parent; the practice of advising the parents as to the progress of the childbirth; and the practice of rendering prenatal and postpartal care.
definition_quote.quote: "Midwifery" means the practice of supervising the conduct of a normal labor and childbirth, with the informed consent of the parent; the practice of advising the parents as to the progress of the childbirth; and the practice of rendering prenatal and postpartal care.

value: supervising normal labor and childbirth with informed consent
advising parents on progress of childbirth
collaborative prenatal and postpartal care for high-risk patients under physician written protocol
administering other medicinal drugs as prescribed by a physician
methods_authorized.quote: A midwife licensed under this chapter may administer prophylactic ophthalmic medication, oxygen, postpartum oxytocin, vitamin K, rho immune globulin (human), and local anesthetic pursuant to a prescription issued by a practitioner licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, and may administer such other medicinal drugs as prescribed by such practitioner.

drug_authority.value: May administer specified drugs (prophylactic ophthalmic medication, oxygen, postpartum oxytocin, vitamin K, rho immune globulin, local anesthetic) pursuant to a prescription from a physician licensed under chapter 458 or 459; may administer other medicinal drugs as prescribed by such practitioner. No independent prescriptive authority.
drug_authority.quote: A midwife licensed under this chapter may administer prophylactic ophthalmic medication, oxygen, postpartum oxytocin, vitamin K, rho immune globulin (human), and local anesthetic pursuant to a prescription issued by a practitioner licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, and may administer such other medicinal drugs as prescribed by such practitioner.

clinical_birth_experience_requirements.value: Care of 50 women in each of the prenatal, intrapartal, and postpartal periods under preceptor supervision; observation of an additional 25 women in the intrapartal period.
clinical_birth_experience_requirements.quote: The care of 50 women in each of the prenatal, intrapartal, and postpartal periods under the supervision of a preceptor. The same women need not be seen through all three periods. (b) Observation of an additional 25 women in the intrapartal period.

collaborative_agreement_required.quote: A midwife may provide collaborative prenatal and postpartal care to pregnant women not at low risk in their pregnancy, labor, and delivery, within a written protocol of a physician currently licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, which physician shall maintain supervision for directing the specific course of medical treatment.

collaborative_agreement_details.value: Collaborative care for high-risk patients requires a written protocol of a physician licensed under chapter 458 or 459; the physician maintains supervision for directing the specific course of medical treatment. Applies to prenatal and postpartal care only for non-low-risk patients.
collaborative_agreement_details.quote: A midwife may provide collaborative prenatal and postpartal care to pregnant women not at low risk in their pregnancy, labor, and delivery, within a written protocol of a physician currently licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, which physician shall maintain supervision for directing the specific course of medical treatment.

independent_practice_permitted.quote: The establishment of an independent practice by one or more midwives for the purpose of rendering to patients midwifery services within the scope of the midwife license.

apprentice_or_student_permit.quote: No provision of this chapter shall be construed to prohibit: (1) The practice of midwifery by students enrolled in an approved midwifery training program.

value: physician licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459
certified nurse midwife licensed under chapter 464
all with a minimum of 3 years' professional experience
supervisor_qualifications_for_apprentice.quote: "Preceptor" means a physician licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, a midwife licensed under this chapter, or a certified nurse midwife licensed under chapter 464 who has a minimum of 3 years' professional experience and who directs, teaches, supervises, and evaluates the learning experiences of a student midwife as part of an approved midwifery program.

value: other medicinal drugs as prescribed by a physician licensed under chapter 458 or 459
authorized_drug_formulary.quote: A midwife licensed under this chapter may administer prophylactic ophthalmic medication, oxygen, postpartum oxytocin, vitamin K, rho immune globulin (human), and local anesthetic pursuant to a prescription issued by a practitioner licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, and may administer such other medicinal drugs as prescribed by such practitioner.

prescription_authority_prohibited.quote: Any such prescription for medicinal drugs shall be in a form that complies with chapter 499 and shall be dispensed in a pharmacy permitted under chapter 465 by a pharmacist licensed under chapter 465.

emergency_transfer_plan_required.quote: Every licensed midwife shall develop a written plan for the appropriate delivery of emergency care. A copy of the plan shall accompany any application for license issuance or renewal.

hospital_transfer_protocol_requirements.value: The written emergency care plan must address consultation with other health care providers, emergency transfer, and access to neonatal intensive care units and obstetrical units or other patient care areas.
hospital_transfer_protocol_requirements.quote: The plan shall address the following: (a) Consultation with other health care providers. (b) Emergency transfer. (c) Access to neonatal intensive care units and obstetrical units or other patient care areas.

value: home (if safe and hygienic and meets department standards)
permitted_birth_settings.quote: If the patient is delivering at home, the home is safe and hygienic and meets standards set forth by the department.

practice_limited_to_nonhospital_settings.quote: Training in hospitals or alternative birth settings, or both.

value: nature and risk of procedures to be used by a midwife
status of the midwife's malpractice insurance, including the amount
informed_consent_required_content.quote: The department shall develop a uniform client informed-consent form to be used by the midwife to inform the client of the qualifications of a licensed midwife and the nature and risk of the procedures to be used by a midwife and to obtain the client's consent for the provision of midwifery services.

malpractice_insurance_disclosure_require.quote: A licensed midwife shall include in the informed consent plan presented to the parents the status of the midwife's malpractice insurance, including the amount of malpractice insurance, if any.

malpractice_insurance_required.quote: the department shall, by rule, require that midwives maintain medical malpractice insurance or provide proof of financial responsibility in an amount and in a manner determined by the board or department to be sufficient to cover claims arising out of the rendering of or failure to render professional care and services in this state.

outcome_data_reporting_required.quote: Beginning July 1, 2018, a physician licensed under chapter 458 or chapter 459, a nurse midwife certified under part I of chapter 464, or a midwife licensed under chapter 467 who performs an attempted or completed planned out-of-hospital birth must report an adverse incident, along with a medical summary of events, to the department within 15 days after the adverse incident occurs.

birth_certificate_filing_required.quote: The midwife shall mail or submit a completed birth certificate for each birth, in accordance with the requirements of chapter 382, to the local registrar of vital statistics within 5 days following birth.

value: Instruct parents regarding requirement for infant screening blood test for metabolic diseases
Notify county health department within 48 hours following delivery unless other arrangements made
Instill prophylactic into each eye of newborn in accordance with s. 383.04
newborn_screening_obligations.quote: The midwife shall instruct the parents regarding the requirement for an infant screening blood test for metabolic diseases as required by s. 383.14 and rules promulgated pursuant thereto, and shall notify the county health department in the county where the birth occurs, within 48 hours following delivery

advisory_council_composition.value: Nine members: one certified nurse midwife; one obstetrician certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology; one family physician certified by the American Board of Family Practice; one pediatrician certified by the American Board of Pediatrics; four licensed midwives; one Florida resident who has never been a licensed midwife and has no financial interest in midwifery or health care facilities.
advisory_council_composition.quote: One member of the council shall be a certified nurse midwife. One member of the council shall be a physician who is an obstetrician certified by the American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology and one family physician certified by the American Board of Family Practice. One member of the council shall be a physician who is a pediatrician certified by the American Board of Pediatrics. Four members of the council shall be licensed midwives. The one remaining member shall be a resident of this state who has never been a licensed midwife and who has no financial interest in the practice of midwifery or in any health care facility, agency, or insurer.
